item.title: Data, Privacy & AI: Resources
item.description:
A curated selection of resources on data protection, privacy and the use of artificial intelligence. Resources in French are marked [FR].

Last updated: November 2026.

Regulation and official guidance

  • CNIL [FR]: the French data protection authority. Guides, recommendations and sanctions.
  • CNIL: Intelligence artificielle [FR]: CNIL’s recommendations for developing and deploying AI systems in compliance with the GDPR.
  • GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679: the official text on EUR-Lex, available in all EU languages.
  • AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: the official text of the European regulation on artificial intelligence.
  • European Commission: AI regulatory framework: an overview of the AI Act and its implementation timeline.
  • European Data Protection Board (EDPB): guidelines and opinions on how the GDPR applies, including to AI models.
